breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly removes the erroneous instruction to 'superpose My·z/Iy and Mz·y/Iz as though the product of inertia were zero.' Instead, it directly instructs the use of the full unsymmetric bending formula σ = -(My·Iz − Mz·Iyz)/(Iy·Iz − Iyz^2)·z + -(Mz·Iy − My·Iyz)/(Iy·Iz − Iyz^2)·y, which properly accounts for the nonzero product of inertia Iyz = 800,000 mm^4. This matches the ground truth prompt.
